translations.web: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
translations.bsb: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
translations.kjv: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
translations.asv: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.
